SERVICES AGREEMENT

This Services Agreement is made on 15 April 2026 between Northwind Analytics Ltd
(the "Provider") and Kestrel Retail Group plc (the "Customer").

1. Term. This Agreement commences on 1 May 2026 and ends on 30 April 2027.
2. Fees. The total fees payable under this Agreement are €48,500.
3. Termination. Either party may terminate this Agreement on 60 days' written notice.
4. Law. This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of Ireland.
